I am writing an "Introduction" chapter for a paper, but I have writer's block. Here is a rough plan/outline:

1) modern machine learning methods are able to generalize really well (more than we might expect)
2) example: computer vision models can process images from very different domains (give concrete examples)
3) example: natural language models can solve a bunch of different tasks (give concrete examples)
4) this generalization ability can be explained by the Universal Approximation Theorem
5) research into this generalization ability is very promising, this paper will explore multi-task and multi-modal machine learning methods
